verdict.rationale: Stripe documents API equivalents for many Dashboard actions. Refunds can be issued via the API or the Dashboard, disputes can be managed programmatically, and the MCP server can call any Stripe API GET/POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE method across customers, invoices, subscriptions, payment links, webhooks, Connect, payouts and more. An OpenAPI spec is also published. However, the pack never states UI/API parity, and several capabilities are described only as Dashboard flows, such as RAK creation, MCP access management and revenue-recovery settings. missing for 10: an explicit documented UI/API parity guarantee, API equivalents for Dashboard-only admin and settings flows (key creation, MCP access governance, no-code revenue recovery), independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can issue refunds by using the Refunds API or the Dashboard
